# Atla

> Atla is a senior-led branding studio founded by José Pablo Domínguez (Founder & Creative Director). It builds brand strategy, identity, packaging and digital systems for companies across the United States and Latin America. The team works from Austin, Mexico City, Barcelona, Lima and Caracas. The studio is based in Austin, Texas.

## Studio

- [Why Atla](https://www.atla.design/about): why a company hires Atla, how the work runs, proof, selected clients and the team
- [Services](https://www.atla.design/services): strategy, naming and voice, identity, packaging, website and decks, motion and campaigns
- [How we work](https://www.atla.design/how-we-work): the steps of every project: read the market, talk to your people, pick the position, design the system, hand it over
- [Programs](https://www.atla.design/programs): the ways in for a company at a turning point: an audit, then a brand system or a full build, then a fractional brand director
- [Hospitality](https://www.atla.design/hospitality): the same ways in, named for hotels and restaurants: audit, rebranding, branding
- [Brand strategy](https://www.atla.design/brand-strategy): how Atla approaches positioning and messaging

## Services

Every discipline, one team. Each link opens that discipline on the services page.

- [Strategy](https://www.atla.design/services#strategy): One position the whole company can repeat, so every team and agency builds on the same thing.
- [Naming and voice](https://www.atla.design/services#naming): A name that clears legal, and a voice that holds from the pitch deck to the shelf.
- [Identity](https://www.atla.design/services#identity): A system that still looks like one brand in the hands of your third agency and your newest hire.
- [Packaging](https://www.atla.design/services#packaging): Packaging you recognize at arm's length and in a thumbnail, across the whole range.
- [Website and decks](https://www.atla.design/services#website): Websites and decks that explain the company when you are not there.
- [Motion and campaigns](https://www.atla.design/services#motion): The brand in movement, without a second system.

The moments Atla is hired for. Each one opens the services page as that moment's route: what usually happens, the disciplines that matter, the engagements that fit and one project:

- [Launch](https://www.atla.design/services?moment=launch)
- [Raise capital](https://www.atla.design/services?moment=raise)
- [Grow](https://www.atla.design/services?moment=grow)
- [Reposition](https://www.atla.design/services?moment=reposition)

The ways in, the same on every page: Audit, Brand system, Full build, Fractional brand director.

## Start a project

- [Start a project](https://www.atla.design/brief): a few questions, one at a time; José Pablo reads every brief and replies by email
- [Brand check](https://www.atla.design/brand-check): free. A short video, what is in your way, ranked by what to fix first, and a written brand check at atla.design/audit/your-brand
